evidence: DoEffectBloodOut (end of PcMain) seeds 10 drip columns with myRand (modelled exactly as the STRICT myRand table lookup), then runs frames until every column passed row 200: each frame calls synchro() once and redraws the whole 320x200 display_buffer from DrawBufferNormal (src/blood.c:19..83). display_buffer is DisplayBufferNormal in normal mode (src/frame.c:277) and DrawBufferNormal the 64064-byte draw buffer (FIRST_INIT, src/cheat.c:347): both are modelled as separate fresh 64064-byte buffers.

boundary.evidence: synchro() is called exactly once per drawn frame (src/blood.c:76); stopping at its third call compares the seeding, two complete column updates and two complete 64000-byte frame redraws (memory written before each synchro call and at the boundary) with an identical call prefix on both sides. The frame loop itself only repeats the same per-frame code until all columns reach 64000 (about 70..100 frames).

budget.evidence: two full-screen redraws (32000 16-bit stores each) per seed
